snippet.title: Rurouni Kenshin: Meiji Kenkaku Romantan: Kansei — [ PSP ] — Intro & Gameplay
snippet.description:
We journey now to a romanticized Meiji era, this is,

Rurouni Kenshin: Meiji Kenkaku Romantan: Kansei

The game is a sequel to Rurouni Kenshin: Meiji Kenkaku Romantan - Saisen and has similar gameplay and graphics. The creators claimed to have improved the gameplay for this game by taking complaints about the first one to heart. Just like the first game the first print contained. The game has a brand new engine and incorporates clips from the anime and all three OVAs.

And granted, this game is improved. It's smoother, it's easier to play, it has more options.
But it's still just plain boring.

I don't recommend this game very much.
